maxSpaces.description: Split the group if a space of this size or more is inserted (null = never split on padding width)

linesBetweenGroups.description: Number of separator lines required to split an alignment group of in-body code (assignment statements, local declarations). Empty lines count once; a standalone N-line comment region counts N-1. Structural groups (ports, params, case items, struct members, struct-pattern assigns) always require 2 separator lines.

indentWidth.description: Number of spaces per indentation level

columnLimit.description: Column limit for line wrapping (0 = no limit)

spacesBeforeTrailingComment.description: Number of spaces before trailing comments

respectUserFormatting.description: When true, preserve user line breaks in expressions if all resulting lines fit within the column limit

excludeDirs.description: Directory names to exclude from formatting, omitted while crawling

dirs.description: Paths (relative to the config file's directory) to format when the formatter is pointed at that config directory itself. Lets a project scope formatting to specific subtrees (e.g. ["fpga"]) without formatting the whole tree. Ignored when a subdirectory or file is targeted directly, so you can still format any path ad hoc.
